clusters.label: Feature Extraction in NLP
clusters.rationale: This candidate explains the general concept and role of feature extraction, without implementation details. No other candidate matches this teachable idea at the same level; the implementation-focused candidate adds practical coding aspects.

clusters.label: Implementing Feature Extraction in Python for NLP
clusters.rationale: This candidate focuses on practical Python coding for feature extraction, which is a distinct implementation skill. The conceptual overview candidate does not cover code implementation, so they are not the same teachable idea.

clusters.label: Building a Python Web API to Serve NLP Models
clusters.rationale: This candidate covers high-level steps and challenges of wrapping an NLP model into a REST API. The Flask-specific candidates are low-level endpoint mechanics and do not represent the same overarching concept.

clusters.label: Creating a Basic Flask API Endpoint
clusters.rationale: This candidate teaches the minimal Flask app structure and route registration, a foundational skill that is distinct from dynamic routing or HTTP method handling, each of which adds a specific technique.

clusters.label: Handling Dynamic URL Parameters and URL Generation in Flask
clusters.rationale: This candidate covers Flask's variable rules and url_for, which is a separate topic from basic routing or HTTP method specification. It represents a specific mechanism not present in other candidates.

clusters.label: Defining API endpoints with HTTP methods in Flask
clusters.rationale: This candidate deals with explicitly setting allowed HTTP methods and inspecting request.method, a distinct aspect from URL parameter handling or basic route creation.
